answer: In arXiv 2602.13244, 'LoRA' stands for Low-Rank Adaptation. It relates to model compression by enabling fast and resource-efficient fine-tuning of large models. LoRA allows for the adaptation of only a subset of the model parameters, typically individual layers, which reduces the number of trainable parameters significantly and lowers GPU memory requirements. This technique is particularly useful for reusing and adapting existing models in a cost-effective and environmentally responsible manner.
